name: Room Protection (NC) — setup, tapeline, teardown
doctrine: Decoupled room-level protection scenario. Activates once per room with at least one active paintable item. Module-level applies_when gates fire per-surface install/remove based on floor/wall/ceiling mask_level (edge/partial/full/encapsulate). Adjacent-surface masks gate on PS key emission (zero quantity = skip). Tape line fires only when tapeline_edge=true. Containment fires only when containment_mode=true.
